title: Calculate minesweeper neighbor counts
summary: A minesweeper board needs a number in each empty cell showing how many mines touch it. Count neighboring cells in all eight directions while retaining the board’s dimensions and mine markers. Produce mine counts for every empty square in a minesweeper board.
requirements: Input is an array of equal-length strings using * for mines and . for empty.
Adjacent means eight directions including diagonals.
Keep mines as * and replace empty cells with digit characters.
hints: For each empty cell inspect its eight neighbors.
Check bounds before reading a neighboring cell.
